title: Shulker Helmet Refreshed
description: Retextures the shulker helmet from supplementaries to match the style of Mobs Refreshed by Lukidon
body:
This pack is very simple and just retextures the shulker helmet from Supplementaries Mod to match the style of Mobs Refreshed by Lukidon. This way, if you're using the pack alongside the mod, you'll have something that looks consistent! :D :D



-btw this looks REALLY stupid because of the shape 😭
